items.title: Microsoft Fixes Exploited Zero Day in Light Patch Tuesday
items.description: Proof-of-concept exploit code is publicly available for two other flaws in this month's Patch Tuesday. In total, the company issued patches for more than 1,150 flaws this year.

items.title: Windows PowerShell now warns when running Invoke-WebRequest scripts
items.description: Microsoft says Windows PowerShell now warns when running scripts that use the Invoke-WebRequest cmdlet to download web content, aiming to prevent potentially risky code from executing. [...]

items.title: Adobe Patches Nearly 140 Vulnerabilities
items.description: The Experience Manager security update resolves 117 vulnerabilities, including 116 identified as cross-site scripting (XSS) bugs. The post Adobe Patches Nearly 140 Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft Patches 57 Vulnerabilities, Three Zero-Days
items.description: Microsoft has addressed a Windows vulnerability exploited as zero-day that allows attackers to obtain System privileges. The post Microsoft Patches 57 Vulnerabilities, Three Zero-Days appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Packer-as-a-Service Shanya Hides Ransomware, Kills EDR
items.description: Shanya is the latest in an emerging field of packing malware, selling obfuscation functionality in order to help ransomware actors reach their target.

items.title: Microsoft Names New Operating CISOs in Strategic Move to Strengthen Cyber Defense
items.description: Promotions across Microsoft’s security organization reinforce the company’s shift toward AI-driven defense and tighter operational oversight under Global CISO Igor Tsyganskiy. items.description: Fortinet has issued an urgent security advisory regarding a critical vulnerability affecting its FortiOS, FortiWeb, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager product lines. The security flaw, identified as an Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature (CWE-347), could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud Single Sign-On (SSO) login authentication.
